Assistant B is correct. Comparing the 2021 profits, Company V ($25 billion) is highest, ahead of W ($21 billion), U ($20 billion), Z ($7 billion), Y ($6 billion), and X ($3 billion). Its CEO is Lisa Brown, which Assistant B states accurately. Its closing caveat about size and profitability is a reasonable but unnecessary addition.

Assistant A only restates the data for Company X, the second-lowest profit in the list. It does not identify the highest-profit company or name its CEO, so it fails the question entirely.
